about: Reviewed conflicts. Only conflicts documented with an ID in ARCHITECTURE.md (section 7 and 15.5). Load after ingesting the source pack: python -m app.ingestion conflicts data/conflicts_reviewed.json. Each side must match exactly one ingested record, or the conflict is not loaded. Status is open for all three because ARCHITECTURE.md gives a working position for each but does not mark any as resolved; only a reviewer changes status here.

conflicts.title: Annual recurring revenue: call transcripts versus board updates
conflicts.resolution: The board's Rs.5.8-6.1 Cr stands as the only period-labelled figure. Leading hypothesis for the transcript: T2's 'forty-eight' was monthly revenue in lakhs, not ARR. T1's 42-45 crore has no reconciling reading yet. Untestable: no export contains a revenue line
conflicts.would_overturn: A revenue export or invoice register that disagrees with the board, or shows monthly revenue far from Rs.48 L

sides.summary: T2: "forty-eight" at the start of the year

conflicts.title: Monthly burn: call transcripts versus board updates
conflicts.documented_in: ARCHITECTURE.md section 7 (C-BURN). The GL figure in section 7 (Rs.2,34,37,530 Apr-Sep) is a total over many ledger rows, not one record, so it is not a side here
conflicts.resolution: Board. GL Rs.39.0 L/month corroborates within about 12%; the gap is unexported cost centres. T2 is impossible: payroll alone is Rs.31.75 L/month
conflicts.would_overturn: A full-ledger export materially different from the board, or a different finance definition of burn

sides.summary: T2: "two point two lakhs a month"

conflicts.title: Atlas engine feature-complete: board update versus Jira
conflicts.documented_in: ARCHITECTURE.md 15.5 (C-ATLAS-DONE). Story keys from TRANSCRIPT_NOTES.md, Day 3, contradictions between records
conflicts.resolution: Jira for ticket status, the board for what the board was told
conflicts.would_overturn: A Jira history showing the stories were closed when the board update was sent and reopened later, which a status snapshot cannot show (TRANSCRIPT_NOTES.md, Day 3)

sides.summary: Board (6 Oct): "the engine itself is feature-complete"
